question.problem: The points $X,$ $Y,$ and $Z$ form a triangle. The points $X$ and $Z$ are $9\,\text{m}$ apart. If the measure of the angle at the point $X$ is ${43}^{∘}$ and the measure of the angle at the point $Y$ is ${56}^{∘},$ how far is point $Y$ from point $Z?$ Round the answer to one decimal place.
question.worked_solution:
The following triangle illustrates the information given.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266767/assets/0df6765fdd30cf0ac74268a4341309a593dd8019c7f66057d36bd4f6c4be5eb2.png)

The Law of Sines states that

$$
\frac{x}{\operatorname{sin}⁡X}=\frac{y}{\operatorname{sin}⁡Y}=\frac{z}{\operatorname{sin}⁡Z}.
$$

In this case, we have

$$
m∠X={43}^{∘},\,m∠Y={56}^{∘},\,y=9,
$$

and consequently

$$
\frac{x}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}}=\frac{9}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}}.
$$

To solve for $x,$ we multiply both sides by $\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}$ to give

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}\times \frac{x}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}} & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}\times \frac{9}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}} \\ \cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}}\times \frac{x}{\cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}}} & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}\times \frac{9}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}} \\ x & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}\times \frac{9}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, $\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}≈0.682$ and $\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}≈0.829,$ both rounded to four decimal places to avoid rounding error. This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}\times \frac{9}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{56}^{∘}} \\  & ≈0.682\times \frac{9}{0.829} \\  & ≈\frac{0.682\times 9}{0.829} \\  & ≈\frac{6.138}{0.829} \\  & ≈7.4,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to one decimal place.
